items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; you may begin contributing from your first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one in MosaicOne
- Contact benefits@mosaicrobotics.example with eligibility questions

Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: Learn the phishing signals: urgency that does not match the sender's usual tone, a request to move conversation to a personal channel, links whose displayed text and destination differ, requests for credentials or payment changes, unexpected attachments, and approaches from someone senior arriving out of the blue.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, became a parent through surrogacy, or foster placement leading to adoption.

Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service. An employee who becomes a parent before reaching six months receives the statutory entitlement their jurisdiction provides, and the company benefit begins the day the service requirement is met.

An employee who gives birth also receives any period of medical disability leave certified by their clinician before the parental leave begins. The disability period is paid through short-term disability rather than as parental leave, and it does not reduce the 16 weeks.

Parental leave for both parents where both work at Mosaic Robotics is 16 weeks each. The company does not pool or reduce the entitlement.

Next steps:
- Confirm your service start date with People Operations
- Discuss timing and leave structure with your manager

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the standard cap cannot be met—a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market—you book the most reasonable available option and note the reason. No pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Book through MosaicOne Travel
- Note exceptions if cap cannot be met

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure and must name the destination, exact dates, workspace address and a description of the work to be performed.

A trip exceeding 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics will confirm employment and provide a letter of assignment but will not sponsor a visa for temporary work abroad.

Work must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

The employee must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service, must be in good standing with no active performance improvement plan or open conduct case, and must not hold a role with export-control obligations, Restricted data access, or physical prototype access.

Always-on VPN is required whenever a company device connects to a network that Mosaic Robotics does not control, including home networks, hotel and airport networks, and coworking spaces. Screens showing Confidential or Restricted material are not visible to other people, and devices are never left unattended in a public place.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days before departure
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Notify IT Security 5 business days ahead

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees; the cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports USD 2,501 to USD 10,000 require director approval and Finance business partner review.

Every trip needs manager approval before booking. Trips with a total estimated cost above USD 10,000 additionally require director approval.

Your claim against the direct manager Dana's approval limit is 3000 US dollars; the policy asks for no more than 2500 US dollars.

Days since the transaction: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Next steps:
- Book flights at least 14 days ahead in MosaicOne Travel.
- Confirm the lodging cap for your conference city with MosaicOne Travel.
- Attach itemised receipts for all expenses USD 25 or more when you submit.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Security and acceptable-use training is completed within 14 calendar days of the start date and refreshed annually.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. The standard configurations for 2026 are a 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory for engineering roles.

Engineering hires clone the relevant repositories, build the codebase or bring up a bench, and land a first small change by the end of the week.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of day 90
- Confirm device receipt and setup

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

An early laptop refresh requires direct manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment. IT sends a prepaid, tracked shipping label to remote employees before their final day, and onsite employees hand equipment to their local IT desk.

Next steps:
- Contact your manager to approve the refresh.
- IT will arrange the swap at your chosen time.

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Formal investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Severity 1 target resolution time is as fast as the facts allow.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations if your concern involves harassment, discrimination or retaliation.
- Review the Workplace Conduct Policy for reporting channels.

You are assigned to the Boston office. Your manager Dana is Dana, Director, Engineering.

As a hybrid employee assigned to a hub office, you are required to work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by your team to ensure onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative.

Next steps:

You have 13.5 PTO days remaining.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne. Requests longer than 15 consecutive business days additionally require director approval. Requests that overlap a declared blackout period require director approval regardless of length.

PTO requests of any length are approved by your direct manager. Longer requests and requests overlapping a blackout period additionally require director approval.

Recommendation — not company policy: You are projected to forfeit 8.5 days on 31 December if unused, so plan to use your remaining balance before year-end.

Your request goes to Dana, your direct manager.

Next steps:
- Submit requests in MosaicOne with 5–15 business days' notice
- Contact Dana (your manager Dana) for approval
- Plan usage before 31 December to avoid forfeiture

A stay of 30 consecutive days or fewer in an approved country requires manager approval under the Remote & Hybrid Work Policy and nothing further from Tax & Legal.

Your trip to Ireland is 20 consecutive days (1–20 October 2026), which is within the 30-day threshold.

Ireland is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Work from another country up to 30 consecutive days in an approved country requires direct manager approval with 21 calendar days' notice.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN, and IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address, obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure, and confirm your travel laptop is company-managed, full-disk-encrypted and on always-on VPN.

Your proposed stay is 42 consecutive days in Germany, an approved destination. Because it exceeds 30 days, it requires director approval, Tax & Legal review, and written notice at least 21 calendar days before departure.

The 42-day stay counts against your rolling 90-day annual limit and remains within it.

You must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN, and IT Security must be notified of Germany at least 5 business days before departure.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad. Tax & Legal review typically approves stays over 30 days with conditions including a hard end date and prohibition on customer-facing activity.

Working from another country differs from international business travel: a business trip of 30 consecutive days or fewer does not trigger Tax & Legal review if your activity is genuinely travel such as meetings, installation, or training rather than the ordinary conduct of your role from a foreign desk.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates (3 November to 14 December 2026) and your workspace address.

Your benefits waiting period ends on 13 November 2026.

Enroll in your benefits elections before 13 December 2026 to avoid default enrollment.
